title: Unit 3: The Next Generation: Future Continuous & Future Perfect
objective: Mampu menggunakan quantifiers untuk membahas jumlah, menggunakan so/such dan do/did untuk penekanan, serta memahami kosakata tentang kostum, seragam, dan pola asuh anak dalam konteks generasi mendatang

theory.summary: Unit ini mengajarkan cara menggunakan quantifiers (kata penentu jumlah) untuk berbicara tentang kuantitas dengan lebih presisi, serta menggunakan so/such dan do/did untuk memberikan penekanan dalam kalimat bahasa Inggris. Materi ini penting untuk berbicara tentang generasi mendatang dan pola asuh anak dengan lebih ekspresif dan akurat.
rules: Quantifiers: Gunakan 'a few/a little/some' untuk jumlah kecil, 'a lot of/lots of/plenty/much/many' untuk jumlah banyak, dan 'most/almost all/the vast majority' untuk hampir semua. Contoh: 'I've got a few followers on my blog' atau 'Most of my teachers are really nice'
So + adjective/adverb untuk penekanan: 'It was so hot that I couldn't sunbathe' atau 'He's so difficult that...'
Such + (a/an) + adjective + noun untuk penekanan: 'It was such a difficult question that I didn't know what to say' atau 'There were such interesting ideas'
Do/Does/Did untuk memberikan penekanan pada kata kerja: 'You didn't like the film, did you? I did like the film!' atau 'She does want to go'
Too + adjective/adverb = lebih dari yang dibutuhkan (makna negatif): 'too + many/much + noun'. Contoh: 'It's too hot' atau 'I have too much work'
(Not) enough = cukup/tidak cukup: 'adjective/adverb + enough' atau 'enough + noun'. Contoh: 'It's not interesting enough' atau 'I don't have enough time'

commonTrap.explanation: Pemula sering keliru menempatkan so dan such. So diikuti langsung oleh adjective/adverb, sedangkan such diikuti oleh noun phrase (a/an + adjective + noun). Jangan sampai tertukar!
commonTrap.wrong: It was so a difficult question. / He is such intelligent.
commonTrap.correct: It was such a difficult question. / He is so intelligent.

readinessQuestions.prompt:
Lengkapi dialog percakapan berikut sesuai konteks:
Sarah: "Did you see that blog about the dad who wore costumes to school?"
Tom: "[...]"
options: Yeah! Rain's dad wore a different fancy-dress costume every single day.
Sorry, I forgot my keys at home.
It was so a difficult question
readinessQuestions.explanation: Respon "Yeah! Rain's dad wore a different fancy-dress costume every single day." ("Ya! Ayah Rain mengenakan kostum yang berbeda setiap hari.") adalah jawaban yang tepat dan alami sesuai alur percakapan tokoh Tom.

vocab.meaning: kostum (pakaian khusus untuk pesta atau pertunjukan)
vocab.collocation: Rain's dad said goodbye wearing a different fancy-dress costume each day
Do you or does anybody you know wear a uniform?
If you think you have the world's most embarrassing dad, then think again
The toughest job in the world: Most parents want to bring up their children well
Tiger mums don't let them watch TV or play computer games. They are too strict for me
My mum and dad are strict and they don't let me do a lot of things my friends do
You mean that he thinks he's trendy, and that he knows which trainers are fashionable
He had always looked on being a mother as straightforward, something like driving

dialogue.context: Percakapan antara dua teman membahas ayah yang berpakaian kostum aneh untuk menjemput anaknya di sekolah

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Did you see that blog about the dad who wore costumes to school?
lines.translation: Apakah kamu lihat blog tentang ayah yang mengenakan kostum ke sekolah?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Yeah! Rain's dad wore a different fancy-dress costume every single day.
lines.translation: Ya! Ayah Rain mengenakan kostum yang berbeda setiap hari.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: At first Rain thought his dad was the most embarrassing person in the world.
lines.translation: Pada awalnya Rain berpikir ayahnya adalah orang paling memalukan di dunia.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: But he eventually realized that his dad was pretty cool after all.
lines.translation: Tapi dia akhirnya menyadari bahwa ayahnya sebenarnya cukup keren.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: I think it's such a creative way to show your kids you care.
lines.translation: Menurutku itu cara yang sangat kreatif untuk menunjukkan kepada anakmu bahwa kamu peduli.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: I do agree! Most parents are too soft on their children these days.
lines.translation: Aku sangat setuju! Kebanyakan orang tua terlalu lunak pada anak-anak mereka saat ini.

speakingLab.context: Diskusi dengan tutor tentang gaya pengasuhan anak dan pendapat pribadi siswa mengenai berbagai metode parenting

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today let's talk about parenting styles. Do you think parents should be strict with their children, or should they be more relaxed? What's your opinion?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I think parents should find a balance. They shouldn't be too strict, but they do need to set some rules.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's an interesting point. Can you give me an example of a rule that you think is important for teenagers?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Well, I think teenagers should help around the house. It teaches them responsibility and prepares them for independence.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent! Now, what about the Tiger Mum style of parenting we read about? Do you think it's too strict, or does it have some benefits?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I think it's too strict for most children. They don't have enough time to relax and enjoy their childhood.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good reasoning! One last question: if you become a parent one day, what kind of parent do you think you'll be?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I'd like to be supportive but firm. I want my children to feel confident, but I also want them to learn important values.

quiz.question: Choose the correct quantifier: 'I've got ____ followers on my blog – more than 200.'
options: a few
loads of
hardly any
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'loads of' untuk menunjukkan jumlah yang banyak (lebih dari 200 followers). 'A few' berarti sedikit, dan 'hardly any' berarti hampir tidak ada.

quiz.question: Complete with so or such: 'It was ____ a hot day that we stopped working and went to the beach.'
options: so
such
too
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'such + a/an + adjective + noun'. Pola yang benar: 'such a hot day'. Jika tanpa noun, baru pakai 'so': 'It was so hot that...'

quiz.question: Which sentence uses 'do/did' for emphasis correctly?
options: I do really like this school.
She didn't like the film, did she? Yes, she did like it.
They do going to the party tonight.
quiz.answer: She didn't like the film, did she? Yes, she did like it.
quiz.explanation: Do/does/did digunakan untuk menekankan kata kerja. Pola: do/does/did + verb infinitive. Pilihan B benar karena 'did like' memberi penekanan pada fakta bahwa dia suka.

quiz.question: Choose the correct option: 'Most parents want to ____ their children well.'
options: bring up
raise up
grow up
quiz.explanation: 'Bring up' adalah phrasal verb yang benar untuk 'membesarkan anak'. 'Raise' juga benar tapi tanpa 'up'. 'Grow up' berarti 'menjadi dewasa' (intransitif).

quiz.question: Which sentence about Tiger Mum parenting is correct based on the text?
options: Tiger mums let their children watch TV and play games.
Tiger mums are too soft on their children.
Tiger mums don't let their children watch TV or play computer games.
quiz.answer: Tiger mums don't let their children watch TV or play computer games.
quiz.explanation: Teks menyebutkan bahwa Tiger mums sangat ketat: mereka tidak mengizinkan anak menonton TV atau bermain game komputer.

quiz.question: Complete: 'There were ____ at the meeting. Some people had to stand.' Choose the correct quantifier.
options: too many people
not enough people
hardly any people
quiz.explanation: Karena beberapa orang harus berdiri, artinya ada terlalu banyak orang (too many people). 'Not enough' dan 'hardly any' tidak sesuai dengan konteks.
